title: A star falls
summary: The basket follows your finger, a star falls. A function makes it fall.
done: You know how the star falls and how the basket catches it.

hello.text: Here is **Star Catcher**! Try it in the preview: drag the basket to catch the star. Then we look at its blocks.

start.text: Everything starts here: [when Sky starts] calls the function “make a star fall”.

drop.text: A **function** keeps blocks under a name. This one puts the star at the top, at random, shows it, then gives it a speed downwards.

catch.text: When the star touches the basket, we call the same function: the star starts again from the top. A function can be used many times!

follow.text: The basket can be dragged (set in Design). This block puts it back on the ground at each move: it only goes left and right.

slow.text: Start **slow motion**: blocks will light up one by one while the game runs.

watch.text: Look: the block [put Star at x … y …] lights up each time a star starts again from the top.
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Well spotted! Stop slow motion to play at normal speed again.

faster.text: Make the star fall faster: 250 or more.
faster.hint: Change the 150 in “make a star fall”.

higher.text: Lift the basket: put 500 instead of 590.
higher.hint: It is in the “when Basket is dragged” block.

spin.text: When you catch the star, make it turn.
spin.hint: Take [turn … by … degrees] from Star, and drop it in “when Star touches Basket”.
